$comment: Fixture manifest for the precrease planner (implementation-plans/reference-finder-integration.md, Phase 4).
`prototype` is the JavaScript spike's upper bound and `panel` the design panel's best-found value
(exhaustive search to depth k WITHOUT O6, under the spike's own predicate); both are recorded in the
plan's evidence table. `crate` is the value oristudio-precrease re-derives with the corrected
predicates, and is what tests/planner_fixtures.rs asserts. Counts can move either way: removing the
spike's O3 external-bisector / O4 foot / O7 crossing false positives raises them, and fixing its
rounded-normal point-on-line index (which hid every +/-45 line) lowers them. `null` means the plan
records no value for that fixture.
Four fixtures are referenced where they already live rather than copied here.

fixtures.description: Bird base molecule, 22.5 degrees; the two midlines and eight corner lines.
fixtures.note: Agrees. Every line closes from the bare sheet. The axioms its witnesses use are O2, O3 and O5 only — not the O5/O6/O7 the plan's evidence table names: with only the four edges and two midlines folded, each 67.5-degree corner line has exactly one lander (the centre onto an edge), and O6 needs two.

fixtures.description: Frog base molecule; nothing closes from the bare sheet until a diagonal is folded.
fixtures.note: Agrees. One depth-1 auxiliary (a diagonal) unlocks all 16 lines; it stays a full crease because later steps use it as an O3 reflection line.

fixtures.description: Synthetic 1/6 grid with both diagonals and two chords.
fixtures.note: Agrees. Four lines close from the bare sheet, then one depth-1 auxiliary unlocks the remaining ten.

fixtures.description: Kabuto (referenced from the Flat-Folder fixtures, not copied).
fixtures.note: Agrees with the panel, not the prototype. The prototype's second auxiliary fold was an artefact of its rounded-normal point-on-line index, which made five of kabuto's +/-45 degree lines invisible from the marks lying on them.

fixtures.description: Oriedita's solution_sample_1 (referenced from the Oriedita fixtures, not copied).
fixtures.note: Agrees with the panel, not the prototype: one auxiliary fold (corner onto centre) unlocks twelve lines.

fixtures.description: Panel counterexample: thirds grid plus both diagonals plus x = 1/9.
fixtures.note: Agrees with the panel. Two things were needed to reach 2: the stuck search must keep deepening until a set COMPLETES the closure (stopping at the first set that unlocks anything gave 3), and the candidate cap must be taken round-robin across axioms — a flat cut of the ease-sorted list drops every O1 candidate, and the second line of the optimal pair is an O1.
Agrees with the panel. Found at depth 3, which the plan's 'depth 3 when the candidate count is small' rule allows (4 root candidates).

fixtures.description: Panel counterexample: x = 1/3 and the slope-1/3 diagonal from the corner.
fixtures.note: Agrees with the panel; found at depth 3.

fixtures.description: Panel counterexample: thirds grid plus both diagonals plus x = 1/12.
fixtures.note: Agrees. The prototype reached 2 folds plus one unsolved line here (6 folds once its deleted 'fold the best approximation' branch ran); the crate solves all seven exactly with two auxiliary folds.

fixtures.description: Panel counterexample synthesised to defeat a greedy stuck handler: two chords, one 1-fold and one 2-fold.
fixtures.note: Agrees with the panel. Reaching 2 needed the lander scan to accept a mirror line that only touches the sheet at a corner: a lander is a point of P on the reflected reference line, and a corner is such a point, but the scan asked whether that line CROSSES the sheet (an in-paper segment longer than TOL) and so lost every corner lander. That false negative alone cost this fixture one auxiliary fold.

fixtures.description: Component 0 of the iguana_24 box-pleated canvas: 1,640 segments merging to 89 lines on a 24-grid.
fixtures.note: Agrees with the prototype's upper bound of 2 (the plan records no certified panel value; its sheet frame was unverified there and is derived from the border loop here). Two of the 89 lines close from the bare sheet; one depth-2 auxiliary pair unlocks the other 87.

fixtures.description: Panel probe search-divergence.mjs case 1: four chords chosen to make the prototype's cost proxy disagree with its real cost.
fixtures.note: No plan value to compare against; recorded so a change in the search is visible. Solved by one depth-1 auxiliary fold.
No plan value to compare against. Solved by one depth-2 auxiliary pair.
